## STEP 1 — EVERY POSITION HAS A ROW
Take each position on the list IN ORDER. Count the rows whose Kind is that position.
  0 rows  → DEFECT: name that position.
  1+ rows → OK. More than one is CORRECT, never a fault.

## STEP 2 — EVERY ROW BELONGS TO A POSITION
Take each row of the table IN ORDER. Read its Kind, then look for that exact word on the list above.
  found     → OK.
  not found → DEFECT: name that Kind.
